approved: Public Governance, Performance and Accountability Amendment (Local Industry Preference) Bill 2026

Moved the Public Governance, Performance and Accountability Amendment (Local Industry Preference) Bill 2026, proposing that Commonwealth procurement support Australian industry and local jobs by prioritising domestic manufacturers for specified projects; the bill was seconded, and debate was adjourned.
